posts.name: Siddharth
posts.cooked:
This is with reference to the OPPE exam for System Commands.

As per the email regarding the SCT dated 27th September, “The meeting link for the SCT has been shared via a calendar invitation. Please check your student email.” However i did not receive any email with the calendar invite. Therefore, requesting your assistance and tagging both of you as the deadline is tonight 11:59 PM @hemalatha @Subendu

Additionally, I noticed that in the SOP document, two checks have been provided, none of which mentions anything about a google meet link (the email received does though):

  1. Positioning of the mobile to get the candidate’s view during OPPE SCT
  2. Candidate’s login to the exam portal from their computer.

posts.name: Puneet
posts.cooked:
Hi,

You can give your SCT in November time period also.

Regards,
Puneet

posts.name: Siddharth
posts.cooked: I did manage to get the Gmeet link from the support eventually. However, if the image uploaded or anything else is not right, I’ll be counting on the November attempt.

posts.name: Puneet
posts.cooked:
Hi,

Yeah sure, that would be a good idea.

Regards,
Puneet
